aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Discover the vision, values and people behind Amovi Travel.
aboutPage.missionText: At Amovi Travel, we are committed to delivering world-class hospitality with a local heart. Our mission is to create meaningful journeys that connect travelers with Afghanistan's rich culture, breathtaking landscapes and enduring heritage — while supporting the people and communities that make this country so extraordinary.
aboutPage.missionQuote: “Luxury should never come at the expense of authenticity.”
